Container.Name: gw2-homestead-sync
Container.Overview: Syncs Guild Wars 2 homestead decorations from the GW2 API and wiki every hour and pushes the changes to the gw2-homestead repo on GitHub. The WebUI is a read-only status page: when the sync last ran, when it runs next, and what each run found.
Container.Requires: Log in to ghcr.io first (the image is private) and add the deploy key to the data folder: see the Support link.

Config.Name: Status page port
Config.Description: Port on the server for the status page (the WebUI). If 8080 is taken by another container, use any free one, such as 8089.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the deploy key (deploy_key), the clone of the repo and the run history.

Config.Name: Sync minute
Config.Description: Minute past each hour (UTC) to run, 0-59.

Config.Name: Run on start
Config.Description: true to also run as soon as the container starts.

Config.Name: Push
Config.Description: false commits in the clone but never pushes (for trying it out).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the sync runs as (99 is Unraid's nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the sync runs as (100 is Unraid's users).
